title: Cage n(7,9): a 7-regular graph of girth 9 with few vertices
statement: Find a 7-regular simple graph whose girth (shortest cycle) is at least 9, with as few vertices n as possible; it shows n(7,9) <= n (cages grow with the girth). The House of Graphs cage table lists no graph for this cell; strict monotonicity in the girth and its (7,11)-graph on 31300 vertices give n(7,9) <= 31298. A graph with fewer than 31298 vertices improves it.
submission: Text file: one graph in graph6 or sparse6 (as House of Graphs gives them; an optional >>graph6<< or >>sparse6<< header is allowed), or an edge list, one edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered from 0.
score: n, the number of vertices of a 7-regular graph of girth at least 9 (smaller is better)

best_known.source: n(7,9) <= 31298: implied by strict monotonicity in the girth (n(k,g) < n(k,g+1), Fu, Huang and Rodger 1997) from n(7,11) <= 31300 [Joo26]; the House of Graphs cage table (houseofgraphs.org/meta-directory/cages; J. Goedgebeur, J. Jooken, T. Van den Eede) lists no graph for girth 9; read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: House of Graphs cage table (houseofgraphs.org/meta-directory/cages; J. Goedgebeur, J. Jooken, T. Van den Eede)
